title: Resolution urging Albany to pass the New York Fair Housing Act
summary: This resolution calls on the state legislature to pass, and the governor to sign, S.6958, which would require municipalities to adopt 10-year fair share affordable housing plans modeled on New Jersey's approach. The bill would mandate minimum shares of units for families with children, rental housing and very low-income households, with 40-year affordability for rentals and 30 years for sale units. It would also create a statewide affordable housing trust fund and an online listing portal.
